assessment.security_status_en: The United States is facing a wave of domestic political and technological shocks, including the fallout from the Nvidia scandal, shifting dynamics in Congress following sweeping Democratic midterm victories, and a temporary nationwide FAA flight ground stop caused by aging infrastructure. Meanwhile, the White House under new Chief of Staff Stephen Miller is reorganizing staff and preparing for upcoming diplomatic talks with China.

articles.title: Will Trump’s lame duck presidency push him further beyond constraints of the law?
articles.summary:
Midterm elections have defanged the US president – leaving critics to worry about his next move in his ‘fat Elvis’ stage

It was just before 3am when Donald Trump entered a crowded Manhattan ballroom, greeted by chants of “USA! USA” and theme music from the Hollywood film Air Force One. On stage, two red “Make America great again” (Maga) caps were mounted in glass cases like holy relics.

That was the scene 10 years ago this week when Trump, a businessman and reality TV star, stunned the world by beating Hillary Clinton to the White House. A decade later an unlikely president is serving an unlikely second term. But in the wake of a humiliating vote of no confidence in last week’s midterm elections, he now enters an endgame wracked with uncertainty.

archive.security_status_cs: V USA probíhá výrazná politická polarizace po nedávných midterms, v nichž demokraté převzali kontrolu nad Kongresem, což vede Bílý dům k zostření rétoriky v čele se Stephenem Millerem. Inflační tlaky nadále zatěžují domácnosti a nutí Federální rezervní systém zvažovat další kroky, zatímco na imigrační a bezpečnostní frontě rostou tenze kolem ICE a justičních střetů. Roste také politická nejistota ohledně budoucí podoby sociálních a daňových politik.
archive.security_status_en: The U.S. is experiencing significant political polarization following recent midterms where Democrats took control of Congress, prompting the White House to sharpen its rhetoric under Stephen Miller. Inflationary pressures continue to weigh on households, forcing the Federal Reserve to weigh further measures, while immigration and security fronts see rising tensions around ICE and legal clashes. Political uncertainty regarding the future shape of social and tax policies is also mounting.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, sharpened rhetoric between the newly elected Democratic Congress and the White House is expected, while markets continue to assess inflation impacts and Fed actions.
